46 To ——[Lines to a Critic]
This lyric is drafted on pp. 342 rev. and 343 rev. of Nbk 15, where it is entitled ‘A Hate-Song’.
 Mary made a fair copy in Harvard Nbk 1 under the title To ——. The rough state of the draft as
well as a few substantive differences between it and the fair copy would indicate either that she
transcribed from an intermediate fair copy made by S. or that he revised his draft while guid-
ing her transcription from Nbk 15. In the draft, for example, the winter of l. 3 is cancelled and
‘frozen’ substituted for it, and the final word of draft l. 13 is ‘move’ not prove. The fair copy was
